caption:
Look at your closest friends for a moment

On that Day, close friends turn into enemies, except the righteous. Choose friends who bring you closer to Allah, and be that friend for someone else.

Surah Az-Zukhruf 43:67

Send this to the friend who reminds you of Allah.

#islamicfriendship #goodcompany #surahzukhruf #quranreels

Recitation: Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi
